  "reasoning": "All 15 final answers agree with the mathematics and their own captured worked solutions. Two worked solutions contain authored errors: q-130894 incorrectly opens with conjugate(kv)=conjugate(v); the correct identity includes conjugate(k), as its subsequent calculation does. q-10248 incorrectly changes the first row to (1,-2,-4) in an intermediate matrix although only R3 is being changed; its final matrix restores the correct first row. These errors do not change either final answer. Individually, the other 13 questions are confirmed. For q-130894, conjugate(k)=(-20+28i)/4=-5+7i, hence Re(k)=-5. For q-82034, conjugate(k)=(-4+8i)/4=-1+2i, hence Re(k)=-1. For q-339664, arrows converge at 0 and diverge at 3, so I and II hold. For q-98700, arrows converge at -2 and point downward on both sides of 2, so I and III hold. Here 'node' uses the supplied definition of an equilibrium with arrows pointing in the same direction. For q-98752, f has signs negative, positive, negative across -1 and 3, making -1 a source and 3 a sink; only III holds. For q-98715, f has signs positive, negative, positive, negative across -1, 2, and 4, so -1 and 4 are sinks and 2 is a source; only III holds. For q-98762, f=-(y+1)(y-2), giving a source at -1 and a sink at 2. For q-340352, f=(y+4)(y-3), giving a sink at -4 and a source at 3. For q-98809, option 0 has positive slopes on both sides of -2 and slopes directed toward 3. For q-96557, option 4 has negative slopes below 0 and positive slopes above 0, with positive slopes on both sides of 2. For q-130010, R2 becomes (28,15,-23), then (30,11,-20). For q-10248, R3=(3,-1,9)+3(-1,2,4)=(0,5,21). For q-72781, R2=(2,1,2,3)-2(1,-2,1,-1)=(0,5,0,5). For q-72757, R2=(-2,-2,1)+2(1,3,2)=(0,4,5). For q-20387, multiplying R1 by 1/4 produces the target matrix. No earlier submitted answer or grade is supplied; the MA evidence here is exclusively the captured worked solutions.",
